caption: The drawing depicts a metallic instrument consisting of a horizontal rod or bar with pointed ends, positioned horizontally near the top of the image. Suspended from the center of the bar by a hooked element are two sets of three long, slender, tapering spikes, giving the impression of two grouped clusters. The metal components are rendered in shades of gray and black, with some shading indicating cylindrical, solid forms and the pointed tips of the spikes. The background is an off-white or beige color, with some minor discoloration and texture visible on the surface. In the lower left corner, there is handwritten text that appears to include names. The composition is simple, with the instrument centered and occupying the upper and central portion of the image, leaving much of the negative space empty.
title: Skewers and Holder
